shapes.name: Clock
shapes.description: An analog clock with draggable hour and minute hands. Set its time manually.

shapes.name: Chart
shapes.description: A bar chart with draggable bar heights and controls to add or remove bars.

shapes.name: Live clock
shapes.description: Show time in a selected timezone and send second, minute, hour, and noon/midnight pulses.

shapes.name: Stopwatch
shapes.description: Start or pause from a run signal or the buttons. Output the last paused result in seconds, including milliseconds; reset clears and stops.

shapes.name: Ruler
shapes.description: Measure physical distances in millimetres and inches.
